answer: Aerial phased-array attestation resists Sybil attacks in an agent economy by binding nodes to spaced radios. On a randomized audit voyage over an open meadow, a drone crossing near local zenith sends signed millimeter-wave challenges and maps replies by angle of arrival and round-trip delay to drop co-located clones. Faking identities requires separate powered transceivers beyond the array resolution. Yet airframe jitter or heavy rain can skew phase estimates and exclude honest agents.
